title: Slate eval case
description: One prompt, the configurations it runs on, and machine-checkable expectations over the agent's transcript. Semantic checks (known graders, their parameters, regexes that compile, configurations that exist) run in slate.evals.suite.

status.description: pending: runs only once its precondition holds

prompt.description: What the agent is told. {name} placeholders come from vars, plus {workdir} (the run's sandbox folder).

runner.description: agent (default): one of the four configurations. strategist: Oneiro's strategist harness.

needs_eval_env.description: The expected behaviour makes films or could spend, so the run must get replay mode and sandbox folders. Configurations whose tools can't take the eval environment skip the case unless --allow-host-env is passed.

block.description: Harness-level blocks for this case, mapped per configuration in configs.json.

files.description: Files written into {workdir} before the run: relative path -> text ({workdir} expands).

film.description: A film scaffolded with slate.state in {workdir}/films before the run, when that module is available. setup.files still land on top.

harness.description: Inputs for a non-agent runner (the strategist harness).
